baseline_trend.validation: decision rule; evaluated on all samples
baseline_trend.note: Fixed decision rule (Mann-Kendall p < alpha and negative Sen slope). The probability column is a monotone transform of the p-value, not a calibrated probability.

uncertainty.disclaimer: Model confidence estimates conditional on the training data, feature set and model family. They are relative scores, not calibrated probabilities and not certainty about the land surface.
